summary: Triple Flag Precious Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K with a news release dated August 5, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 results. Key items include revenue of $129.2 million, net earnings of $156.3 million ($0.76 per share), and operating cash flow of $111.2 million. The company declared a quarterly dividend of $0.06 per share, payable September 15, 2026, marking the fifth consecutive annual increase (annualized $0.24 vs. $0.23). It also repurchased $20 million of shares under its NCIB and raised 2026 GEO guidance to 100,000-110,000. This is a routine earnings and dividend update with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender, or restructuring.
